section_flow.notes: Full-screen black overlay with looping background video and giant blackletter brand logo; tap or press a key to enter the site (uses sessionStorage to remember).
Floating header turns dark with backdrop blur after 50px scroll; gold underlines slide in under hover links.
Faded tattoo photo background with double gradient masking; giant UnifrakturCook brand name with gold-glow text-shadow plus dual outline+filled gold CTAs.
THE WORK heading with prev/next arrows, three-image strip with center image gold-bordered + corner brackets; autoplay every 3s with pause-on-hover and touch swipe.
Decorative double-stroke wavy SVG path in gold + dark gold between sections — scratchy hand-drawn feeling.
Aspect 4:5 portrait inside gold-glow border with corner brackets, paired with all-caps Bebas heading and serif body copy.
Looping background video with dark overlay, gold thin top+bottom rules, centered blackletter h2 + filled gold CTA.
Brand wordmark / quick links / contact / studio hours columns above a scratchy gold divider.

hero_signature: Pitch-black backdrop with a tattoo photo at 40% opacity faded through dual gradients. Giant UnifrakturCook blackletter wordmark glowing gold via multi-layer text-shadow. Statue-of-Liberty SVG icon bounces beside the logo. Dual scroll-reveal CTAs (gold outline + gold filled) below a tracked-out Bebas eyebrow.
notable_features: Click-to-enter intro overlay with looping ambient video and sessionStorage gate
Hand-illustrated Statue of Liberty SVG mascot that bounces beside the wordmark
Gold text-glow effect using stacked text-shadow at 20px and 40px
Gold-border-glow utility (inset shadow + outer shadow + border)
Animated SVG grain overlay using fractalNoise turbulence stepped at 10fps
Scratchy gold divider built from a 12-stop linear-gradient simulating uneven ink
SVG wavy double-line dividers between every major section
Center-image gold border with four corner brackets in the carousel
motion_vocabulary: Scroll-reveal classes (reveal-up / reveal-down / reveal-left / reveal-right / reveal-fade) toggled by IntersectionObserver
Grain overlay animated through 10-step keyframe translate transforms at 0.5s
Gold glow text-shadow pulses on the wordmark
Statue of Liberty torch and figure use independent pulse + bounce keyframes
Carousel auto-advances every 3s, pauses on hover, swipe-enabled on mobile
prefers-reduced-motion disables grain overlay and reduces all transitions to 0.01ms
tailwind_extras_inline_css: .gold-glow (dual-radius box-shadow), .gold-glow-text (stacked text-shadow), .gold-border-glow (inset + outer + 1px gold border), .grain-overlay (fixed fractalNoise SVG bg with stepped translate animation), .scratchy-divider (multi-stop linear-gradient), .scroll-reveal + reveal-up/down/left/right/fade/visible classes. Custom scrollbar with gold hover thumb. Selection color is gold-on-black.
